sources.citation: Berry, Keith & Christine Berry. 1987. A survey of some West Papuan phylum languages. Workpapers in Indonesian Languages and Cultures 4: 25-80. Abepura: Cenderawasih University & SIL.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing. Sec. 3.3 'Phonological features' (pp. 30-32) covers tone (Abun only; Table 2 marks Moraid 'Tone: x (no)'), syllable counts (Moraid 29/50/15/6 % for 1/2/3/4+ syllables), nasalised vowels (only Moraid has them), prenasalised stops (Moraid nti 'fall'); sec. 4.3.1 Moraid (pp. 43-44) is sociolinguistic; the word 'stress' does not occur in the volume; appendix 209-item Moraid wordlist has no stress marks.
